disclosure.heading: Suspension Of Trading On  Cairo Poultry (POUL.CA)
disclosure.content:
Company Name : Cairo Poultry
ISIN Code : EGS02051C018
Reuters Code : POUL.CA
Content :
A release was received from the company regarding the request to suspend trading in the company's shares starting from the beginning of the trading session on Tuesday 22/09/2026 until the approval of the Listing Committee of EGX, where the right to the shares resulting from the merger will be determined for the holder and buyer of the share until the end of the trading session on Monday 21/09/2026.
